'''Force scattering''' was a [[Force power/Legends|power]] that allowed a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to imprint his presence in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] across a specific area, making it very difficult for another Jedi to discern his exact location. [[Kueller]] used this to scatter his presence across a town before confronting [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on [[Pydyr]].<ref name="The New Rebellion">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>
